description: Extension of implementation timescales for application 00195/B/P5 for ' Change of use from builders yard to residential incorporating the erection of a detached 2 bedroom house' dated 13.12.07.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Four unnumbered plans (site plan and a sectional plan) Received: 24/10/2007Amended floor plans, front elevation and side elevations.Received: 15/11/2007Amended plans: rear elevation Received: 27/11/2007)   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The first floor window in the eastern (side) elevation hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, and the lower half of each of the first floor rear (southern elevation) windows shall be obscure glazed and fixed permanently shut, before the proposed house is occupied. This situation shall be maintained permanently unless the Council's written agreement to the contrary is given.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a residetnal house shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 8 - The development shall not be occupied until a 2.0 metre fence constructed of either brick or close boarded timber has been erected along the southern, eastern and western boundaries of the site.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions form the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by 20% if technically possible, by the on-site generation of renewable energy.  The details shall be carried out as approved.
